capabilities: Create and edit OnlyWorlds elements as Markdown notes with typed fields and [[wikilink]] relationships
Sync elements and whole worlds between the vault and onlyworlds.com via Save element, Upload world and Download world
Draw an element's relationships on an Obsidian canvas with labelled arrows
Generate Bases table and card views for each element type
Import and export worlds as OnlyWorlds folders or clipboard JSON
disambiguation: Not a graphical world editor; the world lives as plain Markdown notes you edit in Obsidian, with an optional sync to onlyworlds.com.
extras: Auto-sync only hears edits typed in Obsidian; notes changed by other tools (Atlas, scripts, sync clients) need a manual Upload world. The API key and PIN are stored in the vault's plugin data. Worlds can be used fully local-only with no account and nothing sent anywhere. Docs live outside the README on the OnlyWorlds site; the README also covers edge cases such as hidden and known-of elements, conflict guarding, and format migration with backups.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to store worldbuilding elements with typed fields and links between them, nor any connection to OnlyWorlds world data.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that keeps an OnlyWorlds world as notes in your vault
Atlas, which opens the same world as a folder

summary: Worldbuilding toolset that keeps an OnlyWorlds world as one Markdown note per element and syncs it with onlyworlds.com.
